path_conditions: In byt_gpio_probe(), vg->saved_context is allocated via devm_kcalloc(&vg->pdev->dev, gc->ngpio, sizeof(*vg->saved_context), GFP_KERNEL) under #ifdef CONFIG_PM_SLEEP. devm_kcalloc may return NULL on allocation failure. The buggy version proceeds without checking the result; vg->saved_context is later dereferenced in the PM suspend/resume callbacks (byt_gpio_suspend / byt_gpio_resume), leading to a NULL pointer dereference. The fix adds 'if (!vg->saved_context) return -ENOMEM;' immediately after the allocation.
